description.en: SONORA is a web music player and Discord audio streaming platform with synchronized lyrics, animated album covers, seamless automix, and official music videos.
description.id: SONORA adalah pemutar musik web dan platform audio Discord dengan lirik tersinkronisasi, sampul album beranimasi, mixing antarlagu mulus, dan video musik resmi.

settings.title: Privacy Mode
settings.description: Hide song details and browsing activity from your Discord status

settings.title: Show Browsing Activity
settings.description: Display the current page when no track is loaded in the player

settings.title: Show Album Cover
settings.description: Display the song or album artwork instead of the default SONORA logo

settings.title: Animated Album Covers
settings.description: Automatically upgrade static artwork to animated GIF covers when available

settings.title: Show Timestamps
settings.description: Display the elapsed and remaining song progress bar in Discord

settings.title: Show Buttons
settings.description: Display interactive buttons to open the album or artist page

settings.title: Status Text Display
settings.description: Choose which text appears in the compact member list status
